jobs.title: AirPods Analog Systems Engineer, Power
jobs.description:
The AirPods team is seeking an Analog Systems Engineer to help drive the design, development, and delivery of our next-generation products. As the power and battery management expert, you will sit at the center of cross-functional collaboration and technical decision-making. You will shape the fundamental power architectures that enable future audio experiences, guiding these critical subsystems from early concept through to final mass production.
In this role, you will own and assist with the end-to-end development of power and battery management subsystems. You will establish the subsystem architecture by performing tradeoff studies, tolerance analysis, simulations for power and signal integrity, and system modeling. Working closely with various cross-functional teams, you will guide component selection, assist with schematic and layout reviews, provide guidance on subsystem HW/FW integration, and define system specifications.
Beyond internal collaboration, you will partner directly with silicon vendors to drive the development, bring-up, and characterization of new PMICs and charger ICs. As designs mature, you will author hardware specifications, evaluate vendor datasheets, and support engineering prototyping. Throughout the development cycle, you will execute hands-on hardware and firmware debug, ultimately driving silicon, system, and manufacturing validation to ensure these subsystems scale successfully and reliably from engineering builds into mass production.
Minimum Qualifications
BS/MS EE or equivalent
2+ years of experience in analog/mixed-signal hardware design
Deep understanding of various power mixed-signal building blocks: PMIC, DC-DC switching converter, LDO, charger, battery, PCM, ADC/DAC, temperature sensor, LED driver, ultra-low power design
Strong analog/mixed-signal analysis: tolerance analysis, simulations for power and signal integrity, timing sequencing, spec compliance, system modeling
Proficient in bench testing and equipment usage (oscilloscope, power supplies, electronic loads, DMM, etc.) for silicon and system validation
Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to drive alignment across hardware, firmware, and silicon teams
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in designing low-power, high volume consumer products
Experience leveraging AI tools and automation to accelerate design analysis, simulation, hardware characterization, and validation workflows
Experience with scripting languages such as Matlab and Python
Familiarity with SPICE-based simulation tools
Familiarity with digital interfaces such as I2C, SPI, UART, etc.
Familiarity with the development process of new silicon

jobs.title: Baseband Hardware Design Engineer
jobs.description:
We live in a mobile and device driven world where knowledge of the physical world around us is needed. We rely on this knowledge to get around, to learn about our environment and to enable spectacular new features for custom applications. Apple is meeting those needs as robustly and as creatively as possible and is interested in people who want to help meet that commitment. The success we are striving will be the result of very skilled people working in an environment which cultivates creativity, partnership, and thinking of old problems in new ways. If that sounds like the kind of environment that you find intriguing, then let's talk. These elements come together to make Apple an amazing environment for motivated people to do the greatest work of their lives. You will become part of a team that sets the standard in cultivating excellence, creativity and innovation. Will you help us design the next generation of revolutionary Apple products? Be a part of a premier design team responsible for the architecture, design, implementation, and integration of the baseband system for all Apple products. The applicant should be familiar with computer system architecture and digital design. The candidate will work proactively with other multi-functional engineering groups.
This is an EE (a.k.a baseband HW) position in the Hardware Technology group of Apple and it is one of the most diverse roles out there. This team is responsible for the digital and power management domain of all wireless chipset in Apple products from concept to product announcement. This role also requires heavy cross-functional collaboration with other teams (Apple SoC, battery, sensors, iOS, etc) and therefore, you will also maintain a firm grasp of the entire product landscape outside of wireless design.
Minimum Qualifications
BS and 10+ years of relevant industry experience required
Strong electrical engineering fundamentals
Experience with schematic capture, layout design and review
Strong problem solving and analytical skills
Preferred Qualifications
Strong electrical engineering fundamentals
Solid experience in system integration, e.g. schematic capture, layout design and review, component placement etc
Solid experience in hardware system bring up
Experience in signal integrity and power integrity simulation, e.g. PowerSI, SIwave, HFSS, ADS, etc.
Experience with mobile platform system design, system integration and/or high-volume consumer electronics design
Experience with voltage regulators, LDO, switch mode power supplies (SMPS), power inductors and capacitors
Experience with high-speed and low-speed digital interfaces, e.g. PCIe, MIPI SPMI, RFFE, I2C, USB etc is preferred
Experience in bench-level design verification with high-speed oscilloscopes preferred.
Experience with J-BERT, network analyzer, spectrum analyzer, phase noise analyzer and jitter nice to have.
Experience with clock and timing devices, e.g. crystal resonator, MEMS, TCXO, crystal oscillator nice to have
Experience with wireless chipset, e.g. Cellular, WiFi/BT, GNSS, NFC is a plus
Experience in digital and analog circuit design and validation a plus
Experience in cellular technology and GNSS technology a plus
Strong problem solving and analytical skills
Position will require some international travel when approved to do so

jobs.title: Foundry Interface Engineer – Display / Mixed Signal Technologies
jobs.description:
Can you influence, connect, get results and communicate effectively? As part of our Silicon Engineering group, you will take imaginative and revolutionary ideas and figure out how to turn them into reality! You and your team will apply engineering fundamentals and start from scratch if needed, bringing forward-thinking ideas to the real world. You will work at an exciting silicon design group that is responsible for crafting state-of-the-art ASICs! We have an extraordinary opportunity for Foundry Interface Engineers.
Imagine yourself in our processor design effort, collaborating with design teams and providing technology support, with a critical impact on getting functional products to millions of customers quickly. In this highly visible role, you will be at the center of process technology problem solving, providing design enablement for display and mixed signal products. The primary focus of this position is collaborating with internal design teams and semiconductor foundries. This is a hands-on, dynamic role requiring limited travel to foundries and development sites.
• Work closely with display product and chip design teams to enable chip development, tape out, debug and release.
• Work closely with foundries on silicon process and product issues.
• Manage & evaluate foundry deliverables (PDK documentation, LVS, DRM/DRC, Spice models and tech files) and drive improvements with foundry.
• Participate in technology development, device engineering for next generation process technologies.
• Assess device usage cases to ensure product reliability (safe-operating-area evaluation).
• Manage and mitigate technology risks for multiple projects in parallel.
• Build crucial internal and external connections at suppliers and within Apple.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 10 years relevant industry experience.
Preferred Qualifications
We are looking for applicants with at least 10+ years of experience in semiconductor process technology and manufacturing. Direct experience in PMIC or analog technology development programs is desired.
MS or PhD preferred
Deep knowledge of mixed signal technologies, with emphasis on supporting analog design.
Experience supporting designs with significant digital content is desired.
Prior support of both planar and FinFET technologies required
Prior experience in DDIC, OLED, uLED backplane display products would be ideal
Experience working with PDKs and collateral, such as Spice models, DRM/DRC, LVS, RC tech files, is critical.
Successful collaboration with design (analog & digital) in a positive manner is a key requirement.
Experience with process qualification and yield enhancement is a plus.
Familiarity with reliability mechanisms and device safe operating areas is a plus.
Good data analysis, problem solving, and very strong interpersonal skills required.
Self-motivation and pragmatic execution of tasks is essential.
